# Skeleton

## Skeleton

SkeletonIcon and IconSkeleton draw the skeleton placeholder at the smallest icon size; SkeletonText draws lines of the theme's text or heading height whose widths step back by a fixed sequence.

### Decisions (roster flag `superloom_decision`)

- **No second-system skeleton.** The second system has no skeleton — the roster's `superloom_decision`. That system's template draws the skeleton family as `surface_container_highest` with an `on_surface` 8% shimmer and a radius of 4; the default's shimmer is one ramp step past its container.
- **The sweep is the primary's.** The shimmer's keyframes are the primary reference's skeleton animation, verbatim stops; the paragraph's stepped line widths are its fixed sequence applied per line. Reduced motion shows the shimmer at rest at full cover, as the primary does.

### Platform

Both platforms. On a native platform the shimmer draws at rest, as the indeterminate progress bar draws its bar, because the keyframes are a web style; the percent-width paragraph resolves against the root's layout on both.

## Skeleton

SkeletonPlaceholder draws a box in the theme's skeleton container colour with a shimmer sweeping across it in the skeleton shimmer colour, sized by its props or the placeholder size.

### Decisions (roster flag `superloom_decision`)

- **No second-system skeleton.** The second system has no skeleton — the roster's `superloom_decision`. That system's template draws the skeleton family as `surface_container_highest` with an `on_surface` 8% shimmer and a radius of 4; the default's shimmer is one ramp step past its container. Where the second system is silent the template decides.
- **The sweep is the primary's.** The shimmer's keyframes are the primary reference's skeleton animation, verbatim stops. Reduced motion shows the shimmer at rest at full cover, the state a static capture of the running sweep shows.

### Platform

Both platforms. On a native platform the shimmer draws at rest, as the indeterminate progress bar draws its bar, because the keyframes are a web style.

## IconSkeleton

IconSkeleton is the icon family's export of the placeholder SkeletonIcon draws, at the smallest icon size; the second system has no skeleton, so its values are a Superloom decision.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | none |
| Flags | `superloom_decision` - anatomy or a value decided here, not measured from a reference |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the root. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `size` | `size.icon_01` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{}` |

## SkeletonPlaceholder

SkeletonPlaceholder draws a box in the theme's skeleton container colour with a shimmer sweeping across it in the skeleton shimmer colour, sized by its props or the placeholder size; the second system has no skeleton, so its values are a Superloom decision.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `atom` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | none |
| Flags | `superloom_decision` - anatomy or a value decided here, not measured from a reference |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `width` | `number` | no | The box's width; the placeholder size when omitted. |
| `height` | `number` | no | The box's height; the placeholder size when omitted. |
| `radius` | `number` | no | Composition prop: the corner radius; the skeleton radius when omitted (the chat button's pill passes half its height). |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the root. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `size` | `control.skeleton_placeholder_size` |
| `radius` | `control.skeleton_radius` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{}` |
| wide | `{"width":240,"height":24}` |

## SkeletonText

SkeletonText draws one skeleton line of the theme's text height, a heading-height line, or a paragraph of lines whose widths step back by a fixed sequence, each followed by the skeleton text gap; the second system has no skeleton, so its values are a Superloom decision.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | none |
| Flags | `superloom_decision` - anatomy or a value decided here, not measured from a reference |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `paragraph` | `boolean` | no | Draw `lineCount` lines instead of one. |
| `lineCount` | `number` | no | The lines a paragraph draws; three when omitted. |
| `width` | `string` | no | A line width in points, or a percent string; the full row when omitted. |
| `heading` | `boolean` | no | Draw the lines at heading height. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the root. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `lineHeight` | `control.skeleton_text_height` |
| `headingHeight` | `control.skeleton_heading_height` |
| `gap` | `control.skeleton_text_gap` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{}` |
| heading | `{"heading":true}` |
| paragraph | `{"paragraph":true}` |
| paragraph points | `{"paragraph":true,"width":200}` |
